run_kmeans_codebook: run kmeans clustering on wav2vec features extracted from audio files using FAISS
parse_faiss_specs: parse a FAISS index specification string into PCA, normalization, clustering, and spherical parameters
create_feature_reader: create a Wav2VecFeatureReader to extract features from audio files using a wav2vec checkpoint model
run_feature_extraction: run feature extraction from a TSV list of audio files using a wav2vec model checkpoint
run_pca_and_cluster: run PCA dimensionality reduction followed by L2 normalization and kmeans clustering on wav2vec features
